finding: Targeted refinement improved image quality but lost concept fidelity due to insufficient identity/concept locking in refinement prompt and parameters

root_causes.detail: Adding 'texture', 'detail', and 'realism' keywords to the positive prompt without age-locking caused the model to interpret 'more detail' as 'older face with wrinkles'. The model equated skin detail with aged skin.
Refinement prompt did not include any negative constraint like 'young adult', 'young', 'not elderly', 'no wrinkles'. The age attribute was left unconstrained, allowing free drift.
No identity-preservation keywords or negative prompts were added to prevent character replacement. The refinement prompt did not anchor to the character concept.
The elegant white fantasy dress direction was not reinforced in the refinement prompt. No negative prompt prevented wardrobe simplification or replacement.

Fantasy/cinematic portrait style was not explicitly preserved. The refinement prompt lacked style anchors like 'fantasy art', 'cinematic', 'ethereal'. No negative to block 'realistic photo', 'studio portrait', 'passport photo'.

The refinement package allowed the model too much semantic freedom by only adding detail-oriented keywords without sufficient concept-guardrails. The recipe changes (cfg 6.5, denoise 0.95) further enabled the model to reinterpret the subject.

Denoising strength of 0.95 preserves very little of the original latent structure, effectively allowing a near-complete re-generation of the subject. Combined with a detail-focused prompt, this enabled the model to substitute a different subject entirely.
The refinement package did not include a rule requiring the output to preserve the character's age, identity, and style from the previous V6 candidate. No cross-reference comparison was enforced.

lesson: Quality improvements must be applied WITHIN identity/fidelity constraints, not at their expense. Every refinement prompt needs explicit age locks, identity anchors, style anchors, wardrobe anchors, and negative guards against realistic/photographic drift. Reference candidate preservation must be enforced as a hard constraint, not a suggestion.
